title: Add capacity patterns for small and resource-limited settings
requirements:
- Give indicative capability-team patterns for early, intermediate and mature settings
- Indicate which 4.5.2 roles can be shared regionally or outsourced in small or low-income states
- Distinguish accountable national functions from capabilities that can be pooled regionally or sourced through partnerships
- Describe regional pooling and competency frameworks, and add LMIC capacity-building examples
